transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in a bookkeeping system to ensure accurate financial records and prevent data loss. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-02 ensure data integrity and adherence to double-entry principles, while SAF-03 mandates a robust audit trail for accountability. SAF-04 and SAF-05 focus on fault tolerance and safe degradation, allowing users to access essential functionalities during outages. SAF-06 and SAF-07 emphasize the importance of validating currency conversions and regular backups to prevent discrepancies and data loss.

transcript.statement: The ethical and compliance aspects of the bookkeeping system are crucial for maintaining accountability and fairness. Lastly, RES-07 guarantees fairness in international transactions through multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates. These requirements collectively uphold the integrity of the system and protect users' interests.

transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is essential in a bookkeeping system to protect sensitive financial data and ensure user accountability. requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate financial transaction recording and maintain an immutable audit trail for accountability.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles and comply with local and international accounting standards.
The system shall provide robust error handling mechanisms that prioritize safety while allowing necessary corrections.
The system shall support rapid transaction processing and timely logging of transactions.
The system shall utilize energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall implement role-based access control to ensure data security and integrity.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions for at least 7 years.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: The flexible error handling mechanism integrates safety and audit trail requirements.
The integration of energy-efficient algorithms addresses both performance and sustainability.
Compliance with accounting standards takes precedence over strict adherence to double-entry principles.
